description: Edit an existing calendar event. Only the fields you pass are changed.

calendar.description: Move to this calendar (EventKit ID from calendar_list, not a name).

confirmToken.description: The confirmToken from a confirmation_required error, sent with the same arguments.

dryRun.description: Report what the call would do without doing it.

idempotencyKey.description: A repeat of this key and arguments within 24 hours replays the first result.

noAllDay.description: Convert away from an all-day event.

occurrence.description: For a recurring event: which occurrence, as the occurrenceDate from calendar_events (every occurrence shares one id). Required to edit or delete one unless span is 'all'.

span.description: For a recurring event: 'this' occurrence (default), this and 'future' ones (both need occurrence), or 'all' for the whole series.

title: calendar_edit: arguments
